findings.evidence: template/scripts/model_routing.py:566–581 now uses review_content_identity for committed routing snapshots. template/scripts/task_content_identity.py:53–66 lists paths without -z, splits lines, and passes Git's quoted output directly to rev-parse. With default core.quotePath, non-ASCII filenames are quoted; their blob lookup fails and records null regardless of content. If a failed child commits such a file, subsequent supervisor edits committed to the same file leave both the committed map and clean-worktree path map unchanged. _content_differences ignores HEAD (model_routing.py:586–590), so _reroute_attribution at lines 1027–1029 accepts that changed content as attributable to the child. Use NUL-delimited, unquoted paths for the committed identity.
findings.summary: Committed files with Git-quoted names can change after a failed child without invalidating retry attribution.
